{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Count total and converted
n_total = len(filtered_df)
n_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()

# Compute fraction
fraction = n_converted / n_total

# Print results
print(f"Total NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {n_total}")
print(f"Converted among them: {n_converted}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction}")"}
